metadata.description:
Welcome to the Ultimate Football Heroes Podcast! The official show inspired by the Ultimate Football Heroes books!

Hosted by Issy (goalkeeper, West Ham superfan) and George (striker, Forest loyalist, and a fountain of football trivia), we’re here to celebrate everything brilliant about football on the pitch and in your own garden.

Every Tuesday, we’ll bring you fresh football stories, weird facts, games, and plenty of laughs. 

From your favourite teams and legendary players to the matches you play and the birthday parties you celebrate, this podcast is all about you the fans, the dreamers, and the heroes making football special.

Got a cool match report? 

Birthday shoutout? 

Something brilliant, bonkers or just downright football you want to tell us? 

Drop us an email at [REDACTED] we could feature your story in an upcoming episode!

Fancy even more football goodness? Check out our website for the books, bonus content and more at https://heroesfootball.com/books/podcast/.

Subscribe now and let’s kick off together, the Ultimate Football Heroes Podcast is your place for the beautiful game!

This podcast contains ads. Yoto does not control these ads and they do not represent us or our opinions. Please listen with care.
